title: MV How can I animate a picture (loop) while the person playing is selecting a choice?

posts.author: l0vl3y
posts.body: I'm trying to create a title screen for my game. I want the text to be a bit bouncy (scaling down and up in a loop), which I know how to do just fine. The problem arises when I attempt to have the person playing interact with the choices I created. With the loop command, the choices never show up. Is there any way to make the loop command play in the "background" of the event while the choices appear? I want my picture animated. I would like to know how to create a picture animation that loops while the user can select their choices. Anyways, here is the event:

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Have the image looping be a separate, parallel event.
